parameters.name: IotIdList
parameters.description:
The list of devices to add. Specify the **IotId** of each device. You can obtain the IotId by calling the [QueryDevice](~~69905~~) operation.

>If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey**. If you specify both **IotIdList** and **ProductKey**, **IotIdList** takes precedence.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the devices you want to add belong.

You can view the information about all products in the current instance in the IoT Platform console or by calling the [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) operation.

parameters.name: ShareTaskId
parameters.description: The ID of the sharing task.
